build_jit_kvcache_module: build a JIT-compiled KV cache module for a given row byte size
test_can_use_store_cache: test whether a given row size is supported for the JIT KV cache kernel
run_store_cache: run the store_cache custom op to write key and value tensors into KV cache at specified indices
summarize_store_cache: summarize the store_cache function that stores key and value tensors into KV cache at specified indices
review_store_cache: review the store_cache custom op that mutates k_cache and v_cache tensors with optional num_split tuning
